sources.title: Roblox Unveils AI That Can Dream Up Playable Worlds … | …
sources.snippet: Roblox Corporation has thrown down the gauntlet in the generative AI arms race, announcing its ambitious "world model" capable of what it calls "real-time dreaming": generating fully playable, interactive worlds from simple text or image prompts. The technology, powered by the new Cube Foundation Model, aims to let creators and even players conjure up entire experiences on the fly ...
